items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: But I never met J.P. Johnson until much later, when I was going to high school

ctx.x: But guys like Clarence Profit wouldn't get on the radio, would they.

Yeah, he was coming over WHN, alternating with the Red Devil Stompers. I had heard of J.P. Johnson. He played the style of J.P. Johnson, he did Fats Waller. But I never met J.P. Johnson until much later, when I was going to high school, and when Art Tatum came into New York. But he was the first, like, impression of that style that I... I mean, he was the impression of that style until I heard J.P. himself play it...you know, that impressed me.
